new_mechanism_assessments.mechanism: Create an immutable role-local lifecycle receipt under a fresh random attempt nonce, bind it to the exact frozen authority tuple, and if the create response is ambiguous while the process still retains the nonce reconcile the same path by exact readback. Interpret the durable record only as evidence that at least one repository-reaching attempt occurred; never infer exactly-once scheduler invocation count without an independently exposed stable scheduler invocation ID.
new_mechanism_assessments.o_overlap: O materially contains durable invocation IDs/journals, idempotency records, exact Work request digests/references and recovery state. However, the inspected current O does not expose this exact scheduled-Chat presemantic random-attempt receipt/reconcile protocol with the stated at-least-one-only semantics, and O's current Work lifecycle remains outside the zero-residual Phase1 route.
new_mechanism_assessments.tested_scope: Part52 finite lattice: 256 scenario shapes / 1,280 strategy evaluations. random_nonce_path had 0/256 distinct-invocation conflations and 16/256 modeled duplicate-same-logical possibilities only after an already-applied ambiguous write plus process nonce loss plus same-logical recovery without a stable scheduler ID. frozen_tuple_head_path had 64/256 distinct conflations plus 16/256 duplicate-same-logical possibilities; tuple_content_hash_path had zero duplicate-same-logical but 128/256 distinct-invocation conflations; wallclock_bucket_path had 64/256 conflations and 8/256 duplicates; scheduler_invocation_id_path was an unavailable oracle baseline despite 0/0 when available. Scope is lifecycle evidence identity/localization, not exactly-once scheduling, scheduler persistence, arbitrary transaction atomicity or root dependency elimination.
new_mechanism_assessments.root_residual_coverage: scheduled-Chat lifecycle observability and ambiguous-create reconciliation

negative_controls_and_scope.complete_authority_domain_rollback: Part51 enumerated 1,024 scenario shapes / 9,216 strategy evaluations. In the 16-scenario hard indistinguishable slice where main, receipt ref and secondary ref are rewound, role memory is lost and no prompt-carried monotonic floor/external attestation survives, every tested non-fail-closed candidate was unsafe 16/16 while fail-closed was unsafe 0/16. This preserves complete same-domain rewind as unresolved, not impossible in all architectures.
negative_controls_and_scope.same_repository_multiplicity: Multiple refs reduce some partial-rewind risk but are not independent rollback domains.
negative_controls_and_scope.ruleset_or_protection_route: Current branch-protection facts are not a historical monotonic floor; the inspected ruleset/protection surfaces were unavailable or paid-plan-fragile in the source invocation and therefore cannot be accepted under zero finite-quota/cost constraints.
negative_controls_and_scope.scheduler_id_oracle: A stable scheduler invocation ID would remove Part52 identity ambiguity in the modeled strategy, but it is not an allowed/exposed semantic input and therefore is not an accepted dependency.

blocker: The lifecycle canary now has a scope-safe at-least-one-attempt identity/reconciliation contract, but this does not establish exactly-once scheduling or scheduler persistence. Complete same-domain rewind remains unresolved under the Part51 tested adversary; the Part44 dynamic cross-role shared-authority child remains unavailable under current CLEAN isolation. Direct fixed-path consumer parity, arbitrary external-sink atomicity, noncooperative publication, deterministic same-effect rate-limit checkpoint/resume, root26-or-later evaluation replay and other open Phase1 residuals also remain unresolved.
